description: runetfreedom russia-v2ray-rules-dat: geoip.dat and geosite.dat for Xray and V2Ray with the domains and IP ranges blocked in Russia (antifilter.download, re:filter) and the Russian mobile whitelist, rebuilt every 6 hours. 3X-UI's geoip_RU.dat and geosite_RU.dat.
notes: Data only, no program. The 'runetfreedom russia-v2ray-rules-dat' shortcut in Scoop Apps lists the files.
Upstream releases every 6 hours, and geosite.dat is about 90 MB: 'scoop hold runetfreedom-russia-v2ray-rules-dat'
stops 'scoop update *' from fetching every build; 'scoop unhold' undoes it.
gesu/3X-UI copies the files into its bin folder as geoip_RU.dat and geosite_RU.dat each time it starts.
For Xray itself: ext:geosite_RU.dat:ru-blocked after copying, or XRAY_LOCATION_ASSET pointing to

script: # Data only: the shortcut opens this micro-launcher, which lists the files.
':: runetfreedom russia-v2ray-rules-dat: shows what the package holds and where, then waits for a key.',
':: Written by the gesu Scoop bucket at install time.',
'ECHO runetfreedom russia-v2ray-rules-dat: routing rules for Xray and V2Ray from',
('ECHO Release: ' + $version + ' (tag on GitHub, UTC date and time)'),
'ECHO                refilter, category-ads-all, win-spy and all v2fly lists',
'ECHO gesu/3X-UI copies them into its bin folder as geoip_RU.dat and geosite_RU.dat',
